items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: a lot of that was Will. Maybe I thought of the changes but the [scats] that was probably Will’s. And we were very close. It was really a band of brothers

ctx.x: And we were a great band. You know if somebody came up with something we’d put it in right away. For instance there’s a tune called “Sponge” on the first record. And part of that [scats] was mine but that whole section where there’s [scats] a lot of that was Will. Maybe I thought of the changes but the [scats] that was probably Will’s. And we were very close. It was really a band of brothers and it got to the point, which was part of the point of the second record which was called The Brecker Brothers Band where…
With everybody being a first call musician on their axes, is that partly why bands break up?
